title: email/set.rs: mailboxIds keys treated as newsgroup names
description:
Why this issue exists: create_one_email reads newsgroup names from keys of mailboxIds JSON object, but Email/get and Email/query use hashed SHA-256/base32 mailbox IDs (via mailbox_id_for_group). The set and get/query paths use different identification schemes for the same concept — a correctness bug.

What needs to be done: Align set and get/query to use the same mailbox identifier scheme. Either accept hashed IDs in set with a reverse lookup, or consistently use raw group names throughout.
